newsitem.title: USA: U.S. shares higher in midmorning.
newsitem.headline: U.S. shares higher in midmorning.

text.p: The Dow industrials were higher in mid-morning trading on Wednesday as money rotated into economically-sensitive stocks out of such rate sensitive groups as the high techs, analysts said.

"People are acting on the negative aspects of a strong economy -- higher interest rates -- and the positive aspects -- better earnings in the economically sensitive area," said Phil Roth, chief technical analyst at Dean Witter Reynolds.
The Dow industrials were up 14 at 6910 on rallies in components such as Merck & Co inc, up 1-1/8 at 91-1/2 and Johnson & Johnson, up 1-1/8 at 58-7/8.
